title: Booster Plan Milestone Bonus & Yield Ring-Fencing Directive
content: The Booster Plan milestone loyalty bonus is strictly ring-fenced and cannot be combined or commingled with the 7% upfront certificate profit promotion. Customers electing the milestone bonus are bound to the standard quarterly profit payout cycle. Early redemption notice period: A mandatory 30-day written notice period is required for any capital withdrawal prior to maturity. Early redemption within the first 12 months incurs a 1.0% administrative liquidation fee against nominal certificate value.

title: Booster Plan General Investment Specifications
content: Booster Plan is a fixed-tenor Sharia-compliant lump-sum investment certificate. Minimum investment requirement is AED 10,000 for individual retail investors and AED 25,000 for institutional/corporate entities. Available tenors: 12 months, 24 months, 36 months, and 60 months. Profit is distributed on a quarterly calendar basis directly into the investor designated National Bonds account or local UAE bank account via UAEFTS.

title: Second Salary Retirement & Income Accumulation Guidelines
content: Second Salary is a dual-phase retirement and regular supplementary income plan designed for UAE Citizens and Expats aged 18 to 65. Phase 1 (Accumulation): Client saves a disciplined monthly amount (Minimum AED 1,000/month) for a duration of 3 to 20 years. Anticipated profit rate is 3.25% - 4.5% p.a. reinvested monthly to compound the balance. Phase 2 (Income Payout): Upon reaching the payout date, National Bonds disburses monthly salary tranches (Principal + Accrued Profits) back to the client over a matching 3 to 20 year payout schedule.

title: Second Salary Early Redemption & Surrender Penalty Structure
content: Premature termination during the Phase 1 Accumulation period: If a customer liquidates Second Salary before 36 months, an early surrender penalty of 1.0% of the accumulated principal balance per remaining year of the agreed term will be deducted. Customers facing verified redundancy, medical disability, or permanent UAE relocation can request compassionate full principal recovery subject to documentation approval by National Bonds Sharia & Risk Committee.

title: Saving Bonds Core Savings, Liquidity & Profit Pool Specifications
content: Saving Bonds is National Bonds flagship capital-protected Mudarabah savings bond. Denomination: AED 10 per unit, with a minimum initial purchase of AED 100 (10 units). Profit distribution: Net profits generated from the Mudarabah investment pool are credited periodically. Profit amounts of AED 10 or greater are automatically issued as additional Saving Bonds, preserving compounding growth. Redemptions: Bonds purchased via debit/credit card require a 30-day seasoning holding period before liquidation without fee. Cash or direct bank transfer purchases can be redeemed after 90 days or instantly via the National Bonds Mobile App up to AED 10,000 per 24-hour cycle.

title: AED 36 Million Annual Rewards Program Allocation & Draw Eligibility
content: All Saving Bonds holders qualify for the AED 36 Million Annual Rewards Draw Program. Key prizes: Two grand prizes of AED 1,000,000 each (bi-annual draw), 16 luxury BMW luxury sedans, 4,000 monthly cash rewards. Draw entry multiplier: Every AED 1,000 held for at least 90 continuous days receives double draw entries. Dedicated draws are segregated for Emirati National Savers, Expat Regular Savers, and Minor / Youth Accounts.

title: MyPlan Recurring Direct Debit Savings Plan Rules
content: MyPlan allows systematic automated monthly savings through UAE Central Bank Direct Debit System (UAEDDS). Minimum monthly recurring amount: AED 100. Minimum commitment term: 12 months up to 36 months. Lock-in period: 30 days from each monthly debit. Benefits: Disciplined savers maintaining unbroken debits receive double reward draw chances and an annual loyalty profit bonus. Missed debits: A 30-day grace period is provided. If 3 consecutive debits fail, the plan transitions to standard flexible Saving Bonds without penalty.

title: Term Sukuk Capital Protection & Maturity Provisions
content: Term Sukuk is designed for High Net Worth Individuals (HNW) and Corporate/Institutional treasuries seeking fixed-term Sharia-compliant yield. Minimum commitment: AED 50,000. Available tenors: 1, 2, and 3 years. Expected profit rates range from 4.75% to 5.65% p.a. depending on tenor and size, distributed semi-annually. Early termination is strictly prohibited during the first 6 months; subsequent premature exits require executive approval and result in forfeiture of accrued non-distributed profit.

title: Booster 2026 High Yield Accelerated Promo Terms
content: Proposed promotional campaign offering an extra 1.5% headline bonus for fresh money investments in Booster Plan exceeding AED 250,000. title: Customer Onboarding, KYC & Source of Funds Compliance Matrix
sharia_compliance_ref: Central Bank of UAE Regulatory Framework Compliant
content: All National Bonds accounts require valid Emirates ID verification for UAE residents, or verified Passport copy for non-resident GCC investors. Any single transaction or cumulative monthly deposit exceeding AED 200,000 requires documented Source of Wealth / Source of Funds validation prior to certificate issuance, in compliance with CBUAE Anti-Money Laundering (AML) standards.
